csv_project_name: AE for Alameda Architectural & Engineering Services
csv_agency: County of Alameda Office of Education
csv_scope_of_work: Notice is hereby given that the Alameda County Office of Education (ACOE) of Alameda County, State of California, is seeking statements of qualification from qualified persons, firms, partnerships, corporations, associations, or professional organizations to provide architectural planning and design services to ACOE in compliance with all requirements of the Division of the State Architect (DSA) and other possible agencies. All complete statements of qualification will be reviewed and evaluated and used to develop a shortlist of candidates for upcoming projects. ACOE intends to establish a pool of prequalified architectural firms that may be invited to provide professional architectural services on future projects on an as-needed basis. Alameda County Office of Education ( ACOE ) is responsible for oversight of 18 school districts in Alameda County (K-12 schools) and provides educational support to all our children. ACOE is looking to engage in possible modernization and new construction projects at its administrative building and at other leased and owned facilities. ACOE seeks responses to this Request for Statement of Qualifications ( RFQ ) from experienced entities to provide full architectural services ( Project Architect ) through the design and construction phases of any of the District s projects. This RFQ defines the design services sought from the Project Architect and generally outlines the Project requirements. Briefly stated, ACOE is seeking experienced and proven design professionals to provide planning services for ACOE that will enhance the operational objectives of ACOE.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: AE for Alameda Architectural & Engineering Services
short_description: Prequalification pool for architectural and engineering services for future ACOE facility projects.
project_scope: Request for statements of qualifications to establish a pool of prequalified firms for future as-needed projects for the Alameda County Office of Education. Potential assignments include modernization and new construction at the administrative building and other leased and owned facilities. The notice mentions oversight of 18 school districts and possible projects across ACOE facilities, but no specific building sizes, gross floor areas, structural systems, or technical parameters are provided.
services: Full architectural services through design and construction phases; architectural planning and design; interior design/space planning; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering; structural engineering; compliance with Division of the State Architect requirements.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style prequalification pool for future as-needed projects, without a defined specific project.
- Focus is primarily architectural services for school and administrative facilities, which are generally not core sbp targets.
- Includes civil and structural engineering, but no concrete structural challenge, span, size, or special structure is described.
- Administrative building projects are explicitly less relevant under the guidance.
- Could offer occasional building-related opportunities, but strategic fit is weak due to undefined scope and framework nature.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The documents only mention possible modernization and new construction at the administrative building and other leased and owned facilities, with no area, program, or cost data. A realistic estimate is not possible from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because this is a prequalification pool for unspecified future projects, a realistic fee estimate is not possible from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Qualified persons, firms, partnerships, corporations, associations, or professional organizations with experience providing full architectural services through design and construction phases for education-related facilities and compliance with Division of the State Architect requirements. The notice generally seeks experienced and proven design professionals; no minimum number of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Complete statements of qualification will be reviewed and evaluated to develop a shortlist of candidates for future projects. Specific award criteria or weighting are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: County of Alameda Office of Education (Alameda County Office of Education, ACOE), Hayward, CA, USA. Contact: Charity Hastings. Phone: 510-887-0152. Email: chastings@acoe.org. Website: https://acoe.org/12244_4
notes: Questions deadline: 6/9/2026 11:00 PM PDT. Solicitation documents available online. Project number: 07-25/26. This is an RFQ/RFP to create a prequalified pool rather than a single defined project.
